adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import_remote` the diff shows `open(url).read` (and similarly `SimpleRSS.parse open(...)` in `Jobs::PollFeed`) without passing any timeout options to `open-uri`. That’s a concrete robustness/operability concern for a background job and any synchronous caller (e.g., `TopicRetriever#fetch_http`), but the finding’s claim that it can block *indefinitely* isn’t strictly verifiable from the diff because Ruby/Net::HTTP have default timeouts depending on how `open` is implemented/loaded.
